notes.title: 19.3 The Game WORKS
notes.notes:
The game is fixed
Get away from me

To those of you that have been standing outside of my windows at night, my neighbors really do not appreciate it. STOP SCRATCHING MY CAR.

notes.title: Hark, a fither in the forest?
notes.notes: It has arrived. I know you feral Bungite collectors can never get enough Bungites. So many collectors have become unimaginably wealthy and now there will be a new use. A new rarity. The Sovereign Peculiar. They hail from many different lands. Bungites in the past seemed to have wandered into the temporal distortion up until now. These Bungites come from lands with political intrigue and vast bloodlines. They have chosen to make themselves available to all of you now.

notes.title: Debating Music Update
notes.notes: Silence. Darkness. The void. Hither a single note from the aether. The silence is fulfilled by the graceful sounds of a Bungite in the distance. Hear their cries in the Disputation Chamber.

notes.title: The Release of the Bungites. May the Gods have Mercy on us All.
